# Semyon Morgunov / Семён Моргунов

> Head of FinTech at Yandex Uzbekistan — builds products in Central Asia's fast-growing markets, where product, operations, and unit economics are assembled in parallel. 10 years in tech: worked in Russia and Uzbekistan; consults for companies in Russia, Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan. Since 2009 launched four of his own ventures (one sold to employees, two closed, one on pause). {total} followers across social channels (Telegram {telegram} · LinkedIn {linkedin} · YouTube {youtube}). Based in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.

## About

- Name: Semyon Morgunov (Семён Моргунов)
- Positioning: builds products in Central Asia's fast-growing markets — assembles product, operations, and unit economics in parallel. Brings products to positive unit economics, not just to launch.
- Current role: Head of FinTech @ Yandex Uzbekistan, Tashkent, Uzbekistan (since April 2026) — Yandex Split BNPL, FinTech for Yandex Pro, strategic fintech partnerships
- Past roles: Director of E-commerce / CPO Korzinka Go @ Korzinka (2023–2026, orders ×23 in 3 years (peak 10,000/day), expansion 1 → 9 cities in 12 months, revenue ×2 YoY with positive EBITDA, payments module from scratch: Korzinka became the first retailer in Uzbekistan certified under PCI DSS 4.0, and Korzinka Go was among the first grocery chains in Uzbekistan with instalments on online orders (from May 2024; 3 BNPL providers), CSAT 4.2 → 4.5); Head of Product @ Yandex Services / Yandex.Uslugi (2022–2023, 30+ products in home services, ~6.5M MAU, GMV ×2.2, EBITDA turned positive); Head of Growth & Monetization @ Skyeng / Skysmart (2017–2022, activated 7M+ users, products that became top-3 acquisition channels with positive unit economics); Certified Sales Trainer @ Apple Russia (2018–2019, contractor)
- Geography: worked in Russia and Uzbekistan; consults for companies in Russia, Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan
- Skills: FinTech, P&L Management, Product Strategy, E-Commerce, Growth, Monetization, 0→1 Launches
- Industries: FinTech, e-com, RetailTech, EdTech
- Teaching, mentoring and judging: completed the Startup Instructors Program based on the NSF I-Corps methodology (August 2023); mentor at the President Tech Award 2024 hackathon (IT Park, 120+ teams, $1M prize pool; https://www.it-park.uz/en/itpark/news/president-tech-award-2024-hackathon-results); judge at Techstars Startup Weekend Central Asia (Tashkent, March 2024) and at the TechGenius hackathon (UNDP and IT Park, Tashkent, November 2023); one of five Apple-accredited sales trainers in Russia at the time
- Languages: Russian (primary), English

## Products

- [TofsDevOps](https://github.com/morgunovtech/Tofs_DevOps_bot) — open-source (MIT) Telegram bot, your personal DevOps in Telegram: uptime, SSL, DNS, search and AI-assistant visibility; fixes what it can and stays quiet while everything is fine; self-hosted via Docker or Railway; named after Tofs the Irish terrier
- [Social Tracker Bot](https://github.com/morgunovtech/social-tracker-bot) — open-source (MIT) self-hosted Telegram bot that watches your social accounts: followers on Telegram, YouTube, Instagram and LinkedIn with weekly trends, the life of your channel (joins, leaves, posts, reactions), comment cards for prohibited content and account-security alerts (profile changes, security emails, a 2FA checklist), plus a weekly reputation report on how people and AI assistants find you; deployed via Railway or Docker
- [Found You](https://foundyou.morgunov.tech/en/) — web app that shows what a photo reveals before you post it (EXIF and GPS, place context, device, people in the frame) and makes a clean privacy-safe copy; runs in the browser, the file is never uploaded
- [Fingerprint](https://fprint.morgunov.tech/en/) — web page that explains online privacy in six steps, from opening your laptop to a loaded site: at each step, on your real data, who learns what about you and what to do; runs in the browser, free, no signup
- [Telegram channel «Semyon raspravil plechi» / «Семён расправил плечи»](https://t.me/raschet7) — personal channel on product and career; writing what he'd want to read himself; case studies, working frameworks, personal observations; {telegram} followers; writing since 2022

## Privacy

- [Privacy (RU)](https://s.morgunov.tech/privacy) / [EN](https://s.morgunov.tech/en/privacy) — his privacy page (also at privacy.morgunov.tech): his own tools — Fingerprint and Found You, a password-strength tool coming soon — and «the essential kit», apps that are open source and have a published independent security audit, each card linking to the audit report and the source code (including encrypted DNS: modDNS by IVPN); one open-source ad blocker without a public audit (uBlock Origin) is shown separately and labelled as such; no referral links
